name: agency-continuity-audit
description: Read-only audits for persistent agent goals, evidence, memory corrections, authority, and restart recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Find silent goal, memory, evidence, and restart failures.
interface.longDescription: Audit an agent workspace without modifying it. Distinguish durable goals from prose, verify structured state and correction paths, inspect authority and finance evidence, and report what remains unproven.
defaultPrompt: What would silently fail after a restart?
Which agency claims lack durable evidence?
